result.summary: The page is largely well-structured with no obvious rendering breaks, overlaps, or misalignments. Clipped carousel items and the cut-off card at the bottom were excluded per the instructions. The only findings are minor readability and content-consistency concerns.

issues.description: Secondary grey text, such as the delivery fees (e.g., '€0.90 delivery'), the review count '(500+)', and the search placeholder, appears light grey on white and may fall below recommended contrast ratios.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text color to meet WCAG AA contrast (at least 4.5:1 for body text) while keeping a visual hierarchy.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows '€0 delivery' twice, once as a badge on the image and again in the metadata line, which is redundant.
issues.suggestion: Show the free-delivery information in only one place, or remove the duplicate from the metadata line.
